items.en_title: Aquiraz (CE) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 25 #5
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Aquiraz (CE) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through accreditation (credenciamento); proposals close Nov 25, 09:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
